143970.overview: Soko-Ban (倉庫番, Sōko-ban – “Warehouse Keeper”) is a warehouse-themed puzzle game where players control a worker tasked with pushing crates onto designated storage spots. The challenge lies in carefully planning moves, as crates can only be pushed—not pulled—and getting one stuck means starting over. Known for its clever design and deceptively simple rules, Sōko-ban delivers a mentally stimulating experience that rewards foresight and precision.
